description: This is a live wrestling and brawling show in Springfield, Missouri, where you watch performers from Midget Mayhem Wrestling & Brawling LIVE in the ring, with ringside, VIP and general seating. It takes place Thursday, December 10, 2026, from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM at Abou Ben Adhem Shrine, 601 E St Louis St; tickets start at USD 32, online tickets are limited, and attendees can come early to pre-game and have drinks.
